sentences.en: We will explore every planet that goes around the sun.
sentences.zh: 我们将探索围绕太阳运转的每一个星球。

sentences.en: They explored every avenue in an attempt to avoid war.
sentences.zh: 他们在试图避免战争的过程中考察了所有可能的方法。

sentences.en: Hunting, underwater diving, fishing and exploring are among his interests.
sentences.zh: 狩猎、潜水、钓鱼和探险都是他的兴趣爱好之一。

senses.zh: 探险，探索，探测，探究，[计算机]，探讨
